compute_box_areas: compute areas of bounding boxes given a numpy array of shape [N, 4]
compute_intersection_areas: compute pairwise intersection areas between two sets of bounding boxes
compute_iou_scores: compute pairwise intersection-over-union scores between two collections of bounding boxes
compute_ioa_scores: compute pairwise intersection-over-area scores between two collections of bounding boxes
review_np_box_ops: review the np_box_ops module for bounding box area and intersection operations
